title: A signal in the noise.
text: Meet NetScope. A community plugin built for Hermes Agent, from Nous Research.

title: Your capture. Your machine.
text: Turn a local packet capture into a network investigation. No cloud uploads. No runtime dependencies.

title: One capture. Every connection.
text: Here is a real run on the bundled synthetic capture. Fourteen hundred and eighty packets. Twenty hosts. Eight hundred and twelve flows.

title: Ask. Inspect. Understand.
text: Three native tools let Hermes analyze traffic, answer structured follow up questions, and create an interactive report.

title: Patterns become evidence.
text: Spot scan like behavior, periodic connections, unusual DNS labels, and sudden traffic bursts. Every finding explains the numbers behind it.

title: Follow the conversation.
text: Explore the real network graph. Filter protocols, inspect a host, and replay the capture timeline. One HTML file, with no external assets.

title: Private by design.
text: Packet bodies stay out of reports. Findings are observations, not security verdicts. Capture limits and parsing warnings stay visible.

title: Make the network legible.
text: NetScope for Hermes Agent. Open source. Local analysis. Clearer answers. Explore the code, run the demo, and make the network legible.
